benchmarks.label: Brent

peak.note: Futures intraday wartime high (Wikipedia chronology). Physical Dated Brent (EIA spot via FRED) peaked at $138.21 on 2026-04-07 and was $114.89 on 2026-09-22.

benchmarks.note: Up 0.54% on 5 Oct as UKMTO logged a seventh Hormuz tanker strike and Saudi-backed Yemeni forces and Houthi media traded claims over Bab el-Mandeb. Week-ago uses 2 Oct (3 days prior) — the closest dated figure found this run, not a full week.

benchmarks.label: WTI

peak.note: EIA Cushing spot high via FRED.

benchmarks.note: Held below $91 on 5 Oct, down 0.53% on the day, as markets balanced easing supply pressures against renewed geopolitical risk from the Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb incidents. Week-ago uses 2 Oct (3 days prior) — the closest dated figure found this run, not a full week.
